name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
benefit: AAY: 35 kg foodgrains/family/month; PHH: 5 kg/person/month.
eligibility_text: Eligible NFSA ration-card holders under AAY or PHH.
application_steps: No separate application required. Eligible beneficiaries can collect grain from nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS) using their existing NFSA/AAY/PHH ration card.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Family Head & Members

name: PM-DAKSH
benefit: Free skill training, stipend, certification and placement support under applicable components.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 18-45 from SC, OBC, EWS, DNT or Safai Mitra/waste-picker groups; OBC/EWS family income below ₹3 lakh, while SC/DNT/Safai Mitras have no income limit.
application_steps: Register online via Skill India Digital portal or PM-DAKSH mobile app with Aadhaar and caste/income certificate, select target training course, and enroll in nearest accredited training center.

name: SMILE – Skill Development and Training for Transgender Persons
benefit: Free skill training, ₹1,000/month stipend for non-residential training and post-placement assistance subject to conditions.
eligibility_text: Transgender persons aged 18-45 with a valid Transgender Certificate/Identity Card; no income criterion; training benefit is free.
application_steps:
1. Visit the National Portal for Transgender Persons.
2. Obtain/provide Transgender Certificate / Identity Card issued under the Transgender Persons Act.
3. Apply for SMILE Skill Development & Training component online.
required_documents: Transgender Certificate / Identity Card issued by DM / National Portal

name: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
benefit: 10 kg free rice through fair-price shops during natural calamities and two important festive occasions each year.
eligibility_text: Indian citizen; native/continuous Puducherry resident for at least 5 years; BPL; fishermen excluded.
application_steps: Benefit is disbursed automatically through Fair Price Shops (FPS) to registered Puducherry BPL ration cardholders.
required_documents: Puducherry BPL Ration Card / Red Card
Proof of 5-year continuous residence in Puducherry

name: Delhi Higher & Technical Education Support Scheme
benefit: Tuition-fee assistance/reimbursement for eligible undergraduate students in Delhi institutions.
eligibility_text: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections meeting detailed scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply through the Delhi State e-District portal or through the designated nodal officer of your Delhi State University / College.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Delhi Revenue Dept
Fee Receipt of current academic session

name: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme
benefit: ₹5,000/year first position, ₹3,000 second, ₹2,000 third in applicable university examinations.
eligibility_text: Meritorious students in government colleges meeting scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply through the Haryana Higher Education scholarship portal (HarChhatravratti) via student login.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT Students – Maharashtra
benefit: Tuition fees, examination fees and maintenance allowance under applicable conditions.
eligibility_text: VJNT students resident in Maharashtra meeting course and other conditions.
application_steps: Register and fill the scholarship application on the MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in).

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class
benefit: Annual scholarship for eligible SEBC boys and girls in Standards 1–10.
eligibility_text: SEBC students meeting applicable scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply online on the Digital Gujarat portal or submit physical application through school principal.

name: State Technical Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: Financial assistance for eligible diploma/degree/postgraduate engineering or forestry students.
eligibility_text: Nagaland resident, ST, parental annual income up to ₹6 lakh, eligible course/institution.
application_steps: Apply online through the Nagaland State Scholarship Portal (scholarship.nagaland.gov.in) with verified ST certificate and parental income proof.
required_documents: Parental Annual Income Certificate (up to ₹6 Lakhs)
Technical / Engineering Course Admission Slip & Marksheets

name: Central Sector Scheme of Free Coaching for SC and OBC Students
benefit: Free coaching for economically disadvantaged SC and OBC candidates for competitive examinations and employment opportunities.
eligibility_text: Economically disadvantaged SC/OBC candidates meeting detailed scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply online on the Free Coaching Scheme Portal (coaching.dosje.gov.in) when application cycles open each financial year.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Students with Disabilities
benefit: Umbrella scholarship support covering pre-matric, post-matric, overseas, fellowship, free coaching and top-class education components.
eligibility_text: Students with disabilities meeting the applicable component-specific conditions.
application_steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities with valid UDID card or disability certificate.
required_documents: Disability Certificate / UDID Card (40% or more disability)

name: Modular Employable Skills Scheme
benefit: Vocational training for school leavers, existing workers, ITI graduates and others to improve employability.
eligibility_text: Target groups and course-specific conditions apply.
application_steps: Enroll directly through registered Vocational Training Providers (VTPs) or state skill development nodal centers.

name: Naya Savera – Free Coaching and Allied Scheme
benefit: Free coaching support for eligible minority-community candidates for competitive examinations and admission to reputed institutions.
eligibility_text: Eligible candidates from notified minority communities meeting scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply online through the Ministry of Minority Affairs portal or through empaneled coaching institutes during announced batches.

name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
benefit: Free coaching for eligible SC students for specified competitive examinations.
eligibility_text: SC students residing in Delhi who passed 10th/12th from Delhi schools or are studying class XII, family income up to ₹6 lakh/year, plus prescribed marks conditions.
application_steps: Apply directly through empaneled coaching institutes or Delhi SC/ST Welfare Department with Delhi residence proof and SC certificate.
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate issued by Delhi Revenue Dept

name: Rajasthan Free Hostel Facility for Eligible Students
benefit: Free hostel facilities including accommodation, meals, clothing, study materials, sports, training and special coaching for eligible students.
eligibility_text: SC/ST/OBC/Special Backward Class/EBC students in Classes 6-12 meeting applicable Rajasthan conditions.
application_steps: Apply online through the Rajasthan SSO portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) under SJMS (Social Justice and Empowerment) Hostel Admission application.

name: Rajasthan Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes
benefit: Financial aid covering non-refundable academic fees and maintenance allowance for eligible SC students.
eligibility_text: SC students pursuing post-matric education and meeting Rajasthan scheme conditions.
application_steps: Apply through the Rajasthan SSO portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) under the Scholarship (SJE) module with verified Jan Aadhaar.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Executive Magistrate

name: Dr. Ambedkar Economically Backward Classes Post Matric Scholarship Scheme, Rajasthan
benefit: Financial aid covering non-refundable fees and maintenance allowance for eligible EBC students pursuing higher education.
eligibility_text: EBC students of Rajasthan meeting the scheme's eligibility conditions.
application_steps: Apply through Rajasthan SSO portal using the SJE Scholarship application form with verified EBC certificate.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
benefit: Cashless treatment for covered hospitalization and healthcare services according to PM-JAY package rules up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
eligibility_text: Eligible economically vulnerable families identified under PM-JAY beneficiary criteria (SECC 2011 / Ayushman Card holders; NFSA ration cards in participating states).
application_steps: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or nearest PM-JAY Ayushman Mitra / CSC kiosk with Aadhaar and Ration Card to generate Ayushman Card for cashless hospitalization.

name: Entrepreneurship Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
benefit: Free/assisted entrepreneurship and skill-development training under eligible ESDP programmes to encourage new entrepreneurs and practical business skills.
eligibility_text: Aspiring entrepreneurs, existing entrepreneurs, youth and individuals aged 18 years and above seeking entrepreneurship/skill development.
application_steps: Apply through MSME Development and Facilitation Offices (MSME-DFO) or official Ministry of MSME training notices for scheduled ESDP batches.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
benefit: Eligible candidates can receive skill training/certification support through approved training programmes under the national skill-development initiative.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 15-45 meeting the eligibility requirements of applicable PMKVY training courses (youth, job seekers, and school dropouts).
application_steps: Register on the Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in), search available PMKVY training courses, and enroll at an accredited training centre.

name: Free Congenital Heart Surgery Assistance for Children - Assam
benefit: Eligible children can receive congenital heart surgery/treatment support according to the applicable government programme rules.
eligibility_text: Children from infancy up to 18 years of age residing in Assam who are clinically diagnosed with congenital heart disease requiring surgery.
application_steps: Consult District Early Intervention Centres (DEIC) under National Health Mission (NHM) Assam or designated government medical college hospitals with child diagnostic reports for evaluation and empanelled hospital referral.
required_documents: Assam Domicile / Residence Proof of Parents
Birth Certificate of Child / Age Proof
Aadhaar Card of Parent and Child (if available)

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefit: Eligible residential consumers can receive Central Government rooftop-solar subsidy according to the applicable scheme rules (up to ₹78,000 capital subsidy for up to 3 kW system).
eligibility_text: Indian citizens possessing an active residential electricity connection and suitable rooftop space. Note: This is a government subsidy programme to offset installation costs, not 100% free installation.
application_steps: Register on the National Portal (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) with your electricity consumer number, submit rooftop solar application, get DISCOM technical approval, install via registered vendor, and submit plant commissioning details for direct subsidy disbursement.
required_documents: Bank Account Details for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
